sourceFile: 54. TIU C11-20 Report  find reason NG SPL high 2026.2.2_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable rows but the changed-factor grouping and outcome extraction are not reliable enough for final evidence.
issues: Changed factor combines multiple test conditions and includes the baseline inside changed condition.
Baseline is ambiguous because the report says compare with normal lot but no normal-lot row is cited.
Row 15, 17, and 19 represent distinct process/spec combinations that should not be merged as one change.
Measurement outcome from Test!14 appears to parse defect columns as statistics, not a valid measurement result.
Review title is taken from unrelated Sheet1 spec/time header.
requiredUserQuestions: Is the intended baseline the old press jig 1.32 mg condition or a separate normal lot not shown?
correctionPlan: Rebuild changed factors from Test rows 15, 17, and 19 as separate comparable conditions.
Preserve press jig type, repair status, laser cutting condition, bonding amount, and spec note as grouping keys.
Use NG rate, total NG, input, and defect categories as process-defect outcomes only.
Remove the unsupported Test!14 measurement-stat outcome unless the row content proves a real measurement table.
Set title and purpose from Test report rows, not Sheet1 header rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but they are insufficient and partly misassigned for final evidence.
